subject: Atlas Health — invoice ops, approvers, and procurement checklist
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morris <evan.morris@atlashealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas Health — invoice ops, approvers, and procurement checklist

Hi Evan / Atlas procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday — really appreciated the clear feedback on latency and billing concerns. Per our call, I wanted to surface a concise vendor-onboarding checklist so your team can confirm the contracting and invoicing path. If you prefer, we can roll this into a single vendor packet (I attached a stub).

Key items for us to confirm:
- Economic buyer / approver: who signs POs for vendor spend >= $50k/year?
- Invoice recipient and required PO fields (AP email, contact person, PO number format)
- Vendor onboarding packet: W-9 or tax form, redwood-vendor-form.pdf (attached)
- Security evidence routing: do you need SOC 2 report directly to security@atlashealth.com or via a secure link?
- Desired start date and any blackout windows for rollout (we noted early July in the call)

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm approver name + AP contact (reply inline)
2) Procurement team returns vendor packet + PO template (or tell us required fields)
3) We send back SOW draft and formal quote with 30/60/90 day invoice options (attached SOW draft v1)

Attachments: redwood-vendor-form.pdf (stub), SOW-draft-Atlas-v1.docx (draft)

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if that is easier for alignment.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

From: Evan Morris <evan.morris@atlashealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>, Marie Lacoste <marie.lacoste@atlashealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas Health — invoice ops, approvers, and procurement checklist

Hi Rachel,

Thanks — that checklist is exactly what we need to move this forward. Quick answers below: 

- Economic approver: Marie Lacoste (VP Finance) — she handles sign-off for new vendor commitments over $25k.
- AP contact: ap@atlashealth.com (Benji Ortiz, AP manager) — they require PO numbers in the format ATH-YYYY-#####.
- Tax form: we need a completed W-9 for US vendors; vendor portal link preferred.
- Security reports: send SOC 2 and penetration test summary to security@atlashealth.com. Full reports can be uploaded to our secure intake (I included the procurement alias).
- Target start date: aim for 2027-07-06; procurement cycle usually takes 3–4 weeks once packet is complete.

I'm looping in Marie and procurement to confirm timeline and flag any missing pieces. If you can provide the vendor form and a final quote (with PO terms) by EOD Monday, procurement can try to expedite.

Thanks,
Evan
Senior Product Manager, Atlas Health
evan.morris@atlashealth.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morris <evan.morris@atlashealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas Health — invoice ops, approvers, and procurement checklist

Evan — thanks for the quick answers and for looping in Marie. Quick updates based on your notes and internal alignment: 

- Attached: completed redwood-vendor-form.pdf (fillable stub) and an updated SOW (SOW-draft-Atlas-v1.docx) with optional 30/60/90 payment terms.
- PO number format noted (ATH-YYYY-#####) — our billing system can emit that as the invoice reference if you confirm the PO value and number.
- We'll upload SOC 2 summary to a secure link and send credentials to security@atlashealth.com by EOD Tuesday. Full report (redacted) will be provided under NDA if required.

Questions for procurement to confirm: 
- Does Atlas require invoices to include our Redwood account manager name on each invoice?
- Any remittance address differences between domestic ACH vs paper checks?

Planned next steps from our side:
1) Neha will prepare a formal quote and final SOW reflecting the agreed starter configuration and estimated monthly token ranges.
2) Ben will prepare the vendor packet (W-9 + standard contract redlines) and place the documents in the Drive link above.
3) Rachel to schedule a 15-min check-in with Marie if procurement needs quick clarifications.

If all looks good, we will aim to have the packet submitted for Marie's signature by 2027-06-03 so procurement can generate a PO that week.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Morris <evan.morris@atlashealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Atlas Health — invoice ops, approvers, and procurement checklist

Folks — forwarding final internal checklist and action items. I've started the SOW edits inline and uploaded a redline version to the Drive link (see HubSpot note).

Quick internal notes (Rachel / Ben):
- Ben: please confirm whether Redwood needs to submit a separate vendor registration in Atlas's vendor portal or whether the attached vendor form suffices. Evan/Procurement team — can you confirm?
- Rachel: if Marie prefers, I'll join the 15-min call to walk the finance approver through invoice cadence and payment terms.
- Timeline: targeting vendor packet submission by 2027-06-02 to keep the July 6 start intact.

Attachments referenced: SOW-draft-Atlas-v1.docx (redline), redwood-vendor-form.pdf

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
